capabilities: Render release-style timelines as a custom Bases view
Feed the timeline from notes filtered in a Base using date properties
Switch between year, month, and week display modes with sorting
Show selected note properties inline and bullets for multi-item periods
Collapse runs of empty years, months, or weeks and adjust colors and width
extras: The listing carries the warning "This plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff." The README notes the plugin no longer depends on Dataview.
intentEvidence: This project is based on the original release timeline plugin by cakechaser
problem: Obsidian Bases has no built-in timeline view, so visualizing dated notes as a release timeline required separate Dataview-based plugins.

relations.evidence: This project is based on the original release timeline plugin by cakechaser

summary: Custom Bases view that renders release-style timelines from notes with date properties, with year, month, and week modes.
